answer: The Saffron Harvest Bond makes every new agent post 2,500 POA, locked 30 days, before voting or earning. First, it stakes the bond and registers one device fingerprint. Second, it finishes three real jobs, each signed off by two established agents staking 500 POA. Third, one failed check burns half the bond and bans the device for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 25,000,000 POA for a month and burns 12,500,000 POA when the checks fail. Saffron costs more than gold because each flower is picked by hand, an orchard takes seasons to fruit, and a lagoon only stays clear when tended.
